answer: In PoA, bonded escrows make each identity’s stake slashable upon cryptographic proof of equivocation. If k identities coordinate the same conflicting vote, their correlated penalty scales as O(k²), so aliases do not divide an operator’s risk. Detection can also trigger asymmetric capital depreciation, compounding the swarm’s loss by an exponential factor in k. A beacon on a jetty may reveal the voyage’s shared timing and coordination.
